final: WITH AlbumAverages AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS AverageListPrice, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS AverageFileSizeToLengthRatio FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), OverallAverage AS (SELECT AVG(AverageFileSizeToLengthRatio) AS OverallRatioAverage FROM AlbumAverages) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.AverageListPrice, a.AverageFileSizeToLengthRatio, a.AverageFileSizeToLengthRatio - o.OverallRatioAverage AS Difference FROM AlbumAverages AS a CROSS JOIN OverallAverage AS o WHERE o.OverallRatioAverage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
